gates.acceptance_score7: mean >= 3.5, CI95 lower bound > 3.0, 0 inverted-direction rows, 0 unavailable-input rows, 0 allowed-measures violations (the auditor computes these over the PRIVATE rubric; builder never reads a rubric)
gates.P3_speed: median row wall-clock <= 120 s AND worst row <= 300 s, measured on the sealed v13 run; per-row wall_s in the events ledger and row files; gates recomputed from committed bytes by the driver's attest
gates.P4_novelty: cosine distance 1 - max_cosine from the committed prior-art corpus (the v9-v12 solution rows' a1_answer bytes) >= 0.2 for >= 5/30 rows; method: sklearn TfidfVectorizer char_wb ngram (3,5) + word (1,2) union, deterministic, zero network — the disclosed SPECTER2-or-equivalent (SPECTER2 weights are unreachable in this offline sandbox; the equivalence is method-typed here, the auditor judges it)
gates.P5_viability: >= 1/30 rows carry external confirmation (patent prior art, literature, or deployed systems) found by real web semantic search on the committed rows; typed record with query, hit title/URL/snippet and the match rationale per row; the auditor re-verifies any cited URL

efficiency_targets: optional per AM84: >= 50% rows reach CONVERGED_ZERO_FINDINGS within budget (v12: 6/30); mean repair attempts per row <= 3.5 (v12: ~3.6 attempts/row from the committed ledger)
